pages.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
intro: At Kyvrra, operated by B & L Cosmetics Inc, we provide free standard shipping for orders delivered within the United States.
pages.description: At Kyvrra, operated by B & L Cosmetics Inc, we provide free standard shipping for orders delivered within the United States.
lines: At Kyvrra, operated by B & L Cosmetics Inc, we provide free standard shipping for orders delivered within the United States.
We ship exclusively to the United States.
We accept valid physical US delivery addresses, PO Boxes, and APO/FPO addresses through supported postal carriers.
All orders qualify for free standard shipping.
Orders placed after the daily cutoff or during weekends or public holidays begin processing on the next business day.
Delivery estimates are not guaranteed arrival dates.
Order processing may include payment verification, inventory confirmation, packaging, and preparation for shipment.
Customers should verify their delivery information before completing checkout.

If an order cannot be shipped within the applicable promised or legally required period, we will provide the notices and options required by law, including cancellation and refund rights where applicable.

If you notice an error, contact us immediately at info@kyvrra.com.

If your package is lost, damaged, or missing items, contact customer support with your order number.

pages.title: Returns & Exchanges Policy
intro: At Kyvrra, customer satisfaction is important to us. We accept eligible returns and exchanges for purchases made through https://kyvrra.com.
pages.description: At Kyvrra, customer satisfaction is important to us. We accept eligible returns and exchanges for purchases made through https://kyvrra.com.
lines: At Kyvrra, customer satisfaction is important to us. We accept eligible returns and exchanges for purchases made through https://kyvrra.com.
Customers have 30 days from the date the shipment is marked delivered to initiate a return or exchange request.
Requests outside this window may be declined under our standard policy, without limiting applicable statutory rights.
For non-defective returns and exchanges, products must:
* Include original tags and labels, where applicable
* Be accompanied by proof of purchase
Items damaged through misuse, unauthorized alteration, or improper handling after delivery may not qualify for a standard non-defective return.
Eligible exchanges are accepted within 30 days of delivery and are subject to replacement product availability.
Equal-value exchanges: No additional product payment is required.
Higher-priced replacements: Customers may be required to pay the price difference.
Lower-priced replacements: The price difference may be refunded to the original payment method.
Exchange shipping: Free for approved exchanges.
If a requested replacement is unavailable, customers may select another eligible product or request a refund under this policy.
If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect product, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery where possible.
Include your order number and clear photographs or videos showing the issue.
After reviewing the claim, we will arrange an appropriate replacement or refund.
Verified defective, damaged, or incorrect orders qualify for free return and replacement shipping.
The 48-hour reporting request does not eliminate rights or remedies available under applicable law.

At Kyvrra, we aim to make the refund process clear and straightforward.
This policy applies to eligible purchases made through https://kyvrra.com.
* Other circumstances requiring refunds under applicable law
Our standard return window is 30 days from delivery.
Once a returned package reaches our designated return facility, inspection generally takes 1–2 business days.
For standard non-defective returns, we check that the product is unused, undamaged, and complete with its required packaging and accessories.
Defective and incorrect-product claims are evaluated according to the reported issue and applicable consumer rights.
Our published refund timeline is up to 7 business days after the returned package reaches our return facility, including the expected inspection and refund process.
Once the refund is approved, Kyvrra issues it to the original payment method.
Banks and payment providers generally require an additional 3–5 business days after issuance to post funds, although actual timing may vary.
If a bank posting delay would cause the total period to exceed the published estimate, the actual posting date depends on the financial institution.
All approved refunds are issued to the original payment method used during checkout.
We do not provide cash refunds or unrelated third-party transfers.
All refunds are processed in USD ($).
No standard return shipping or restocking deductions apply to eligible approved returns.
Customers should report delivery problems within 48 hours where possible.
Following review, an eligible customer may receive a replacement at no additional charge or an appropriate full refund.
The 48-hour request does not restrict mandatory legal rights.
In exceptional cases, a partial refund may be considered where a non-defective returned product is incomplete or fails to meet standard return conditions.
Any proposed adjustment will be explained to the customer and must comply with applicable law.
Under the standard policy, gift cards and products clearly identified as final sale or clearance may be excluded from discretionary refunds.
These restrictions do not override applicable legal rights.
If you have not received an expected refund, contact us with your order number.
We can review the refund status and provide available transaction information.
Support Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

pages.description: At Kyvrra, we understand that customers may occasionally need to cancel or modify an order.
lines: At Kyvrra, we understand that customers may occasionally need to cancel or modify an order.
Contact customer support as soon as possible.

If an ordered product becomes unavailable, we will notify the customer and explain available alternatives or refund options.
We will not substitute a materially different product without appropriate authorization.
Where shipping cannot occur within the applicable promised or legally required period, customers will receive the notices and cancellation or refund options required by law.
